name: td-synnex-mcp
description: Every StreamOne ION reseller API, plus a local licence book for renewals, margin and cross-distributor true-up.

td_synnex_account_id.title: StreamOne ION account ID
td_synnex_account_id.description: Your StreamOne ION reseller account ID (portal Quick Access > Account Information). Fills {accountId} in every API path.

td_synnex_access_token.title: ION access token (leave blank)
td_synnex_access_token.description: Optional override; leave blank. Run `td-synnex-cli auth mint --refresh-token-stdin` once instead: it saves the token this server reads, and `auth mint --if-expiring 15m` keeps it fresh. A pasted access token expires after 2 hours and keeps overriding the saved one.

td_synnex_refresh_token.title: ION refresh token (leave blank)
td_synnex_refresh_token.description: Leave blank. Read only by `td-synnex-cli auth mint` before its first exchange; the MCP server never uses it. ION refresh tokens are single-use, so pipe it to `auth mint --refresh-token-stdin` instead.

td_synnex_base_url.title: Base URL override (testing)
td_synnex_base_url.description: Optional; leave blank. Sends every ION call to this base URL instead of https://ion.tdsynnex.com/api/v3, for tests and mock servers. It is never saved to the config file.

td_synnex_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
td_synnex_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to 1 to remove every tool that can change StreamOne ION (orders, cancellations, cart checkout, customer and product changes, subscriptions set). Any value except blank, 0, false, no or off turns it on. It also removes sync and the learning writers; the tools it keeps still write the synced store, command journal and recall statistics. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to make changes.

td_synnex_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
td_synnex_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Leave blank for Claude Desktop.

td_synnex_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
td_synnex_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to StreamOne ION. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

td_synnex_tail_max_pages.title: tail page cap
td_synnex_tail_max_pages.description: Optional; leave blank. Raises the 50-page cap the CLI tail command drains per poll. Not used by MCP tools.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
